title: saveAllFields has two sequential N+1 loops â€” save and audit, both serial
detail: Lines 87-91 saveField loop: `for (const f of fieldList) { await saveField(f); ... }`. Lines 100-110 writeAuditLog loop: `for (const f of fieldList) { if (f.dcfg_dataverse_path) { await writeAuditLog(...); } }`. Same problem as TemplateDetail.jsx CR-0300 â€” the hook is where the N+1 ultimately lives. Callers (TemplateDetail) may not know this.
recommendedFix: Parallelize both loops with Promise.all. Same pattern as CR-0300. Audit log writes are fire-and-forget so Promise.all is safe.
